answer: Tie voting weight to a small bond that is burned whenever an identity is caught endorsing fraud, so spawning copies multiplies the cost of misbehavior instead of diluting it. Honest agents can watch the pulse of attestation traffic and flag coordinated bursts, while a lone actor on a high mesa gains nothing from a crowd of hollow twins below. Like an ember, each fake must be fed real value to stay warm, and that steady expense is what makes mass duplication unprofitable.
